synopsis: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-4:2021 defines test-design techniques, as stated in both Chapter 9 and the glossary [f7113, f15349]. Chapter 9 places Parts 3 and 4 within generic software and systems testing and reports that neither contains collision-avoidance content [f7114]. The glossary confirms that limitation while identifying their contribution as discipline for separating test processes, techniques and documentation [f15350]. For planning, these standards therefore offer generic testing structure rather than collision-avoidance-specific guidance [f7114, f15350].

relations.note: Both identify the 2021 Part 4 standard as defining test-design techniques.
Both report that Parts 3 and 4 contain no collision-avoidance content.
Explains the generic standards’ value despite their lack of collision-avoidance content.
